# Howmay 皓梅 — 台灣漢字美術字與標準字設計師
# Howmay Wang — Taiwanese Chinese Lettering & Logotype Designer

皓梅（Howmay Wang）是台灣的漢字美術字（Lettering）與標準字（Logotype）設計師，目前於知名台灣字體公司 justfont 從事字體設計、行銷與教育推廣工作。

Howmay Wang is a Taiwanese designer specializing in Chinese Lettering and Logotype design, currently working at justfont — a leading Taiwanese type foundry — in type design, marketing, and design education.

## 創作特色 / Creative Approach

皓梅的漢字美術字作品以手繪為核心，大多以 Procreate 繪製完成，並少部分輔以貝茲曲線向量工具，因此筆觸、材質與色彩豐富而真實，保留了手感與溫度。每件作品均保留創作過程的縮時影片，完整記錄從草稿到完稿的手繪過程。

Howmay's Chinese lettering works are rooted in hand-drawing, primarily created in Procreate with occasional use of vector bezier tools for refinement. This approach preserves the richness of real brushwork, material texture, and color depth. Each work is accompanied by a timelapse video documenting the full creative process from sketch to final piece.

作品超過數百件，風格多變自由，橫跨傳統書法風格、現代感標準字、裝飾性美術字、品牌 Logotype 等類型，同時兼顧創意表達與設計專業度。

With over hundreds of works, the portfolio spans a wide range of styles — from traditional calligraphic lettering to modern logotypes, decorative display type, and brand identity wordmarks — balancing creative freedom with professional craft.

## 專長領域 / Areas of Expertise

- 漢字美術字（Chinese Lettering）
- 標準字設計（Logotype Design）
- 手繪字體（Hand-lettered Typography）
- 字體設計推廣與教育（Type Design Education & Advocacy）
